name: Seaman Recruit
explanation: Enlisted in Miami on 30 June 1997 and went through recruit training at RTC Great Lakes as a Seaman Recruit, E-1. The boot camp portrait is SR. Promoted to Seaman, E-3, only on completing RTC.

name: Seaman
explanation: Promoted to Seaman, E-3, on completing RTC; Seaman through the USS Tortuga TAD and NTC Great Lakes, until Electronics Technician Third Class in December 1998. The seaman group rate mark is three diagonal stripes; on dress blues they are white on navy.
note: Date of rate is the RTC completion date in the record (units.json: 5 September 1997).

name: Electronics Technician Third Class
explanation: First petty officer grade. The rating badge is an eagle over the Electronics Technician mark over one chevron.

name: Electronics Technician Second Class
explanation: Second class petty officer. The advancement exam was taken at NCTS San Diego and scored in the top 1 percent. Date of rate May 1999. The rating badge has two chevrons under the eagle and the Electronics Technician mark.
note: Exam at NCTS. Top 1 percent is recorded.

name: Electronics Technician First Class
explanation: First class petty officer. The rating badge has three chevrons under the eagle and the Electronics Technician mark. Chevrons and service stripes go gold in 2009; this promotion badge is red.

name: Chief Electronics Technician
explanation: Chief petty officer. Date of rank 16 September 2014, last year at JCSE. The rating badge gains a rocker over three chevrons, and the uniform changes to khakis with the fouled-anchor collar device. Held until retirement.
